info.screen.roleid.delayer:
Killer faction
You can see through the camera's position by turning on mission perspective.
You can buy pliers in the store, with 3 points of durability and a 30-second cd. Right-clicking on the camera will disable the camera for 90 seconds.
Passive skill: When you kill a player, the time will be increased by an additional 20 seconds.
Active skill: Press the skill button to consume 75 coin to anchor the current state. The anchor point will automatically retrace after 20 seconds. Retracement will be forced when receiving non-forced damage.
The retrace skill can retrace the location, money, and potion effects, but cannot retrace the inventory and item cooldown.
Backtracking is not a teleport, but a smooth return to the anchor point along the original path: the position is recorded every 2 seconds during the anchoring period, and the backtracking is teleported back in reverse order.
During the rewind, the same gray and white filter will appear on your screen, and other players will be briefly dazed and the sound of breaking glass will be heard. Cool down for 120 seconds.
Note: If you are hit while the anchor point is still there (within 15 seconds), you will be forced to backtrack immediately, and you will fall to the ground and be unable to move for 30 seconds after the backtracking.
Grenades are not available for purchase in the store, but surveillance malfunctions are cheaper.
When you are on the field and there is only 1 minute and 25 seconds left in the game, 30 seconds of game time will be added (only triggered once).

Players who cross the frame will be blinded for 3 seconds each time, and the cooldown of frame teleportation is 3 seconds.

info.screen.roleid.stalker:
Killer faction
Stage 1--[Unable to purchase stores, only lock picks]
1. Infinite running, with a layer of shield.
2. Press the skill button to absorb energy until entering the second stage.

second stage
1. Hunting dagger: Get a knife, and you can buy a second knife in the store. It can be placed in the off-hand, and you can left-click the knife. The knife in the off-hand will not be displayed when the main hand is not holding the knife.
Left-click the knife to sprint, right-click to charge and use it. When sneaking, the charging time becomes 0.1s. When the charge is full, it will be automatically released if there is someone in front of it, and the main hand knife will enter cooling. If the off-hand knife is not on cooldown, right-click to use the off-hand knife to thrust. Cooldown time is 10 seconds.
2. Unable to run
Conditions for the third stage: Kill a certain number of people with the dagger and accumulate full energy.

three stages
Unlock sprint. You can quickly raise the knife without sneaking. Press the Q key to sprint. You can sprint along the y-axis. The cooldown is 2.5 seconds. The stalker can only sprint on the ground.

info.screen.roleid.puppeteer:
Neutral faction
Victory with the killer
Have killer perspective
Stage 1--Faction: Neutral
1. You can right-click a corpse to make it disappear and recycle it.
Evolution conditions: After collecting a certain amount of corpses, you will become a Killer faction (except for the puppet master) [The number of corpses collected is the total number of people in the game divided by six, and the skill of collecting corpses has a ten-second cooldown]
